metadata.urc:note: Rows are the authoring form; this is the canonical form. Round-trip with --check.

attrs.schema:name: base
attrs.urc:comment: The parent of every profile. Rows every viewport answers regardless of device. Nothing here touches a pointer.

attrs.schema:name: cad-blender
attrs.urc:comment: Blender-style: middle drag orbits or rotates, shift+middle pans, ctrl+middle zooms, wheel zooms, numpad period frames the selection, Home fits.

attrs.schema:name: mouse
attrs.urc:comment: A three-button mouse with a wheel. Left selects and drags, wheel zooms about the pointer, right is left to the app's menu.

attrs.schema:name: cad-fusion
attrs.urc:comment: Fusion-style: middle drag pans, shift+middle orbits or rotates, wheel zooms about the pointer, left selects. Left drag on space is a marquee in CAD; here it is left to the app.

attrs.schema:name: comfy-standard
attrs.urc:comment: ComfyUI's Standard navigation: left click selects and left drag on space is a marquee; space+drag or middle drag pans; wheel scrolls the canvas and ctrl+wheel zooms; pinch zooms. Its Drag Navigation mode (the older default, left drag on space pans) is mouse.json.

attrs.schema:name: elinor-jones
attrs.urc:comment: The site example from docs/ACTIONS.md (Harold's note of 2026-10-04): double tap opens a container, double tap on space zooms a step, double tap on a card zooms until readable and then opens the reader; no resizing by accidental finger drags. Under post-pipe's rule 2, binding container.toggle here takes it off the single tap.

attrs.schema:name: post-pipe-engine
attrs.urc:comment: post-pipe's engine defaults, row for row from src/lib/actions.js defaultBindings plus what docs/ACTIONS.md lists as fixed. graph.collapseGesture 'doubletap' swaps the first two container rows. Loading this profile should leave a site behaving exactly as it does today.

attrs.schema:name: gamepad-standard
attrs.urc:comment: The W3C standard mapping. Left stick pans, right stick zooms (Y) and rotates (X), triggers zoom, d-pad walks the navigation cursor, south activates, east goes back, bumpers cycle profiles, start opens the menu. Glyphs come from the controller id.

attrs.schema:name: keyboard
attrs.urc:comment: Movement by code (layout independent), mnemonics by key. Nothing fires while typing. Held keys are axes.

attrs.schema:name: phone
attrs.urc:comment: One thumb on a small screen. Double tap on a card zooms until it is readable, then opens it; the phone's own back swipe is the app's back; no resize by accidental drags.

attrs.schema:name: touch
attrs.urc:comment: Tablets and touch laptops. One finger pans space or moves an item; two fingers pinch, twist and tap to zoom out; a pen hovers like a mouse.

attrs.schema:name: small-touch
attrs.urc:comment: Watches, kiosks, car and embedded screens: one contact, no pinch, big targets. Zoom comes from a crown or bezel if there is one, else from a tap on space.

attrs.schema:name: switch-scanning
attrs.urc:comment: One or two accessibility switches. With one, the cursor scans on a timer and the switch activates. With two, the first steps and the second activates. A switch arrives as a key (often Space or Enter) or as a gamepad button. Moving is the camera following the cursor; zoom is a double press.

attrs.schema:name: trackpad
attrs.urc:comment: Two-finger scroll pans (not zooms), pinch zooms, Safari's rotate gesture rotates. No middle button exists, so its row is removed.

attrs.schema:name: tv-remote
attrs.urc:comment: A TV or streaming remote arrives as keyboard events: arrows, Enter, Back, colour and media keys. No pointer, so arrows walk the cursor instead of panning; holding an arrow pans.
